x_1755386_safetr_0_bfd_policy_knowledge.guidance_text: When a card is not received, cancel the undelivered card, verify the mailing address, and reissue. Expedite delivery for travelling customers. No financial dispute unless fraudulent use is detected.
x_1755386_safetr_0_bfd_policy_knowledge.keywords: card not received, reissue, address verification, delivery
